edges.src: Complaint, US v. California (Oct 15, 2026); ECF 107-4 ¶¶4–7; ECF 149 p.23

edges.title: Prosecutors: ballot suits & charges → Chief election officials
edges.what: U.S. Attorney’s request to the Washington Secretary of State to set aside ballots of 405 alleged noncitizen registrants

edges.title: Secretary of State → Homeland Security Investigations
edges.what: California roll as of Aug 2025 (name, address, DOB; no SSNs). Purchased from the California Secretary of State (buyer not named in the declarations; DOJ’s ECF 57 says DHS) and given to HSI by a DHS senior counselor about Mar 19, 2026, under a release letter barring transfer without the Secretary’s authorization
edges.src: Bartell #2 ECF 107-2 Ex. A p.9; McLoughlin Decl. #2 ECF 107-3 ¶¶5–6; Common Cause v. DOJ ECF 57 (Oct 16)

edges.title: Ballot-hold demands → FBI field offices & IC3
edges.what: Election officials report cyber incidents to FBI field offices or IC3 (D). The investigating agency then holds the evidence (I)

edges.title: Ballot-hold demands → FBI field offices & IC3
